item.text: I’m doing a wider audit now for the last raw attribute and metric-map constructions around search telemetry. The goal is to convert the remaining “grab map, mutate map, pass map” patterns into bundle-aware calls where that actually reduces duplication.

I’ve reached the point where the remaining duplication is mostly API surface. I’m checking whether the old `Map<String, Object>` overloads on `SearchResponseMetrics` are still used anywhere; if not, I can trim them and leave the telemetry-bundle variants as the single path.

I’ve confirmed the plain `Map<String, Object>` metric overloads aren’t used anywhere outside `SearchResponseMetrics` itself. I’m pruning them now so the metrics API only exposes the bundle-aware path for telemetry, which should make the remaining search code more consistent.

I’ve removed the unused map-based metrics overloads. One more pass now: I’m checking whether any external code still reaches into the telemetry bundle for the sole purpose of metrics, because that would be the last place left to streamline.

I found one clean abstraction boundary left: the metrics layer still needs a mutable attributes copy in exactly one place. I’m moving that copy operation onto `SearchTelemetryContext` so the metrics code stops knowing how the immutable bundle is represented internally.
The mutability boundary is now on the bundle, not the metrics class. I’m doing a last sweep for any lingering ad hoc copies or stale imports after that change.

The remaining telemetry fetches are now either inside the bundle itself or inside the metrics helper. I’ve confirmed there are no remaining external uses of the old map-based metrics overloads, so the API surface is smaller and the async handlers are all on the same bundle path.

Refactored the remaining search telemetry plumbing so the bundle is the primary handoff and the metrics helper no longer exposes unused map-based overloads.

What changed:
- Added [SearchTelemetryContext.mutableAttributes()](=/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/SearchTelemetryContext.java) to centralize the one mutable-copy boundary needed for derived metrics.
- Simplified [SearchResponseMetrics.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/rest/action/search/SearchResponseMetrics.java) to keep only the telemetry-bundle overloads for search telemetry reporting.
- Kept the async search phases on the bundle path in [AbstractSearchAsyncAction.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/AbstractSearchAsyncAction.java), [DfsQueryPhase.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/DfsQueryPhase.java), [FetchSearchPhase.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/FetchSearchPhase.java), and [TransportSearchAction.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/TransportSearchAction.java).

Result:
- The remaining search telemetry reporting now consistently flows through `SearchTelemetryContext`.
- The only raw attribute-map work left is inside the bundle construction and the one metric that must add `time_range_filter_from` before recording.

Verification:
- `git diff --check` passes.
- I did not run Gradle tests in this checkout.
